root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `parseIdentifier()` may evaluate the leftmost `*in` in its identifier-scan condition, it must establish `in != end`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `identifier_probe.probe_ptr == identifier_probe.end_ptr` at the last dereference event, so the missing guard is false exactly when the protected `*in` read executes. The fixed original still executes the same `identifier_probe` event, but its last recorded dereference satisfies `probe_ptr != end_ptr`, showing the reordered guard now prevents a one-past-end read.

nodes.description: At the crashing `parseIdentifier()` condition, the emitted dereference operand `in` already equals `end`, so the leftmost `*in` probe reads one byte past the logical end of `m_buffer`.

edges.relation: The pointer value produced by the loop body's last `++in` is the same `in` value dereferenced by the next condition evaluation.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records `identifier_scan_advance.in_after_increment == identifier_probe.probe_ptr` for the last advance/dereference pair.
